questions.stem: Scenario S3, multi-agent research system. Forty entries, each with a source field, pass through a summariser and then a writer, and the finished report names no sources. What should have been done at the hand-off?

options.text: Give each run more material, so that the summariser has more detail to keep
options.says: Ruled out because "A source survives as long as it travels with its claim in a field", whatever the volume.

options.text: Ask the writer to cite sources by recalling each figure's original publication
options.says: Ruled out because "the sources are lost in the compression and cannot be rebuilt from prose".

options.text: Pair each claim with its origin as structured data at every exchange between the stages
options.says: The page says "a compression step keeps them next to the text it produces", so the pairing survives every step.

options.text: Give all the subagents one search tool, so that every trail looks alike
options.says: Ruled out because "Every hand-off between agents carries claim-source mappings", which a shared tool does not provide.

questions.stem: Scenario S3, multi-agent research system. Two reports state 12% and 9% for one measure, and each carries a 2024 date. What label does the write-up carry?

options.text: A change, ordered with the older value first and the newer last
options.says: Ruled out because "With different dates they are `changed`, listed oldest first", and these dates are equal.

options.text: A conflict, with both values and their publishers
options.says: The page says "Two findings for a claim with different values and the same date are a `conflict`".

options.text: An agreement, at the mean of the two values
options.says: Ruled out because "the number appears in no source and cannot be checked".

options.text: A conflict, settled in favour of the larger publisher's value
options.says: Ruled out because "choosing one value hides a disagreement the reader needs".

origin.section: A date can explain a difference

questions.stem: Scenario S3, multi-agent research system. A subagent half remembers a statistic but finds no document stating it. What should its output hold?

options.text: An entry that names the subagent itself as the origin of the number
options.says: Ruled out because the design is to "make the source part of the schema and required", and a subagent is not the source of a fact it recalls.

options.text: An entry that fills the source field with the most likely publication
options.says: Ruled out because "What the pipeline never does is fill the field with a plausible name".

options.text: An entry with an empty source field that the writer is asked to complete before it goes out
options.says: Ruled out because "a finding without one is refused where it enters the pipeline".

options.text: No entry for it among the results, plus a note that it could not be traced
options.says: The subagent "reports it separately as unsourced, or leaves it out".
